subject.title: [Bug]: ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME} is not process when installing a skill

question: Should OpenClaw expand `$VAR` and `${VAR}` placeholders in shared user/workspace path strings such as skill install workspaces, and what should happen when a variable is unset?
rationale: Changing shared path resolution affects config/env semantics across skill installs, agent workspaces, config paths, and other callers, so automation should not choose unknown-variable behavior or compatibility policy alone.

options.title: Expand known vars only
options.body: Expand `$VAR` and `${VAR}` from the selected env source, leave unknown placeholders literal, and add focused resolver plus skill-install tests.

options.title: Limit to skill install workspace
options.body: Handle this report in the ClawHub skill install path only, reducing blast radius but leaving other user path callers inconsistent.

options.title: Wait for broader dotenv policy
options.body: Defer this issue until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/38259 settles env interpolation semantics, keeping the current bug open longer.

recommendation.title: Expand known vars only
recommendation.body: Expand `$VAR` and `${VAR}` from the selected env source, leave unknown placeholders literal, and add focused resolver plus skill-install tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows `steipete` carrying the shared home-dir resolver and config/path cleanup work most often.
